conflict_resolutions.WHOLE_END_ACTOR_DISAGREEMENT: Executive Order 14148 revokes the order as a whole by name on its signing date, 2025-01-20. The other actors named by the machine record are same-day concurrent revocations or supersessions of conflicting provisions dated 2025-01-20, or later recitals, each described in the source notes; none gives a date earlier than 2025-01-20 and none is needed for the first end, which is taken from Executive Order 14148.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held registered text of Executive Order 13988 is the official Federal Register text layer at 86 FR 7023, PDF pages 1-3 (Federal Register / Vol. 86, No. 14 / Monday, January 25, 2021); it names Executive Order 13988 of January 20, 2021, Preventing and Combating Discrimination on the Basis of Gender Identity or Sexual Orientation, and runs from the title to the signature block. The complete clause inventory was checked against the numbered section headings of that text. Section 2(d) of Executive Order 14148 of January 20, 2025 (Initial Rescissions of Harmful Executive Orders and Actions, 90 FR 8237, Federal Register of January 28, 2025) lists Executive Order 13988 of January 20, 2021 among the executive actions that section 2 declares hereby revoked. The held text of Executive Order 14148 states no effective date later than its signing, so the revocation operates from its signing date, 2025-01-20. Whole-order revocation by name is the first end of every clause that had not already been exhausted by performance. The order has no other ending instrument before 2025-01-20 in the packet's later-event chain, which for this order lists besides Executive Order 14148: Executive Order 14168. Each such instrument is recorded in the source notes with its date and why it is not an earlier end; none reinstates this order. The packet's name search of held order texts for this order's number returned, among texts dated on or after 2025-01-20, only Executive Order 14148 and Executive Order 14168. The later-source search is recorded by the three machine searches selected on the sheet: the U.S. Code release point 119-121 (edition current through 2026-10-09), the eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with the CFR bulk files, and the Federal Register executive-order disposition catalog; their coverage statements were read and each is marked complete. Savings are addressed in the savings statement. The first end of the whole order is 2025-01-20.

Statutes, regulations and other instruments that the order cites keep whatever force they have independently of it, but they are not clauses of the order, so no independent command keeps any clause running after the revocation.","savings_check":"Savings were examined in the order's own text and in Executive Order 14148: section 2 contains no saving clause for the revoked orders, section 3(b) leaves existing actions to later review, and section 4 saves only statutory authority and Office of Management and Budget functions. The state is transferred_or_accrued for actions already taken, with no specific surviving action identified from held sources.","scope_check":"Section 2 of Executive Order 14148 revokes the order as a whole by number and by title, without limiting words and without excepting any clause, so the ending is not confined to part of the order. Section 4(a) of Executive Order 14148 states that nothing in it impairs the authority granted by law to an agency or the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget; that preserves statutory authority and does not preserve any clause of this order."}

savings.reason: Section 3(b) of Executive Order 14148 directs the Director of the Domestic Policy Council and the Director of the National Economic Council to review all Federal Government actions taken pursuant to the orders, memoranda and proclamations listed in section 2 and to take necessary steps to rescind, replace or amend such actions as appropriate. Because rescission of actions already taken is left to later action, Federal actions already taken under Executive Order 13988 before 2025-01-20 were not themselves revoked by section 2 and stood until rescinded, replaced or amended individually. No held source identifies a particular surviving action or its later fate, so none is asserted.

source_notes.date_qualification: 2025-01-20: same signing date as EO 14148; the order of the two signings within that day is not established; no later date is claimed.
source_notes.reason: Executive Order 14168 of 2025-01-20 (90 FR 8615) contains a provision stating that its requirements supersede conflicting provisions in previous Executive Orders, naming this order. That provision supersedes only provisions that conflict with EO 14168; it does not revoke this order as a whole, and the held text does not identify which clauses conflict. It bears the same date as EO 14148, so it cannot make the first end of any clause earlier than 2025-01-20.
